correctness.rationale: A nonnegative, mass-one stationary solution exists at the critical parameter as a coefficientwise supercritical limit with uniform second-moment bounds. The stationary generating identity and endpoint moments imply an exact scalar ODE; a reciprocal bound proves q(w)~2/log(1/w); positive-coefficient upper/lower bounds transfer that to R_N~2/logN. The downstream moment and cutoff statements follow rigorously. Computational checks are supplementary.
